notes: Zoka Quantic mainnet: Ironwood (Halo 2, no trusted setup) with X-Wing note encryption from its first block.
Pre-genesis: there is no genesis block and no seed yet. Nothing mines until the genesis is compiled into the binary.
It never mixes with Zenith or with the Quantic testnet: it announces its own protocol id and uses its own gossip topics.
Its nodes listen on P2P port 28380 by default (Zenith 28080, Quantic testnet 28180, regtest 28280).
